findings.summary: The 'independence' of the Wave 1 architecture review cannot be established from repository evidence; the entire governance claim (which authorizes flipping ~14 ADRs) rests on unverifiable self-attestation. All 5 commits in the ConPort CRS v2 chain share the same unsigned author identity within a 61-minute window, and WAVE1-ACCEPTANCE.json itself records the reviewer's personal identity as UNKNOWN_NOT_ENCODED_IN_SUPPLIED_REVIEW_ARTIFACTS.

The merged ADR text (PR head) differs byte-for-byte from the text Wave 1 hash-pinned as 'reviewed' (WAVE1-REVIEWED-ADR-DIGESTS.json pins the pre-effectuation 'proposed, pending' commit, not PR head). No artifact in the bundle binds the two by hash; the bundle's own WAVE0/WAVE1-VALIDATION.json correctly mark 'pr-head-pin' as NOT_RUN. Auditor's manual line-by-line comparison found the transform faithful, but this is not a cryptographic guarantee.

adr-002's authority table row was rewritten in place (conport → conport-crs-v2 write target) rather than appended as a labeled amendment, unlike the other 19 modified ADRs. Content matches the accepted change set's intent; flagged only because it's the one case of in-place decision-prose edit rather than pure append.
WAVE0-DISPOSITION.json discloses added H1 headers on skeletal adr-201 and duplicate adr-213 so the deprecation notice has a heading to follow; confirmed honestly self-reported and content-neutral.

remaining_risks: Merge-gate risk: the PR's own proof bundle states implementation_authorized=false, merge_authorized=false, wave2_authorized=false, and lists 'embedded audit', 'PR-scoped audit', 'PR-head pin', and 'explicit merge authorization' as outstanding follow-ups. Authority-legitimacy risk (see F1): downstream tooling should not treat 'Wave 1 ACCEPTED' as a strong independent-governance signal without out-of-band confirmation of who actually performed the review.

Hash-binding risk (see F2): future automation must not assume WAVE1-REVIEWED-ADR-DIGESTS.json describes the ADR text now live in the repo post-merge — it describes the pre-effectuation text. No PR-head-pinned digest set exists yet in this bundle.

embedded_audit.rationale: Docs/governance-only PR (20 modified ADRs + 1 new ADR + proof/conport-crs-v2 wave0+wave1 bundle, no code paths touched). Candidate diff verified to match actual git history byte-for-byte on spot-checks; internal status-flip consistency against disposition/acceptance records holds; committed binary custody artifacts (bundle + 2 zips) hash-verified against sidecars and reconstructed via git-bundle-verify; no secrets or embedded instructions found. Two material, self-disclosed provenance gaps keep this below a clean PASS: (1) 'independent' Wave 1 review authority rests on unsigned same-author commits within a 61-minute window with reviewer identity marked UNKNOWN in the bundle's own acceptance record; (2) no digest set in the bundle is hash-bound to actual PR-head content — only manual line-by-line comparison (not cryptographic) establishes effectuation fidelity. No evidence of fabrication, injection, secret leakage, or undisclosed scope creep. Full agent transcript and reasoning retained in session (agentId a4ddf939bd8069935).
